author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This is truly a sad tale...She sold her soul long ago. Though always accompanied she will always be alone. For she has no loyalty save one, her youngest. He too will see the shapeshifter when the light comes on. The damage will be irreversible and irreparable. His fate is that of his father. Both are caused by the wickedness that lies within her. The puppet master will rejoice, for she will have no other but him. That was his plan, knowing she could not see more than two steps forward.

text: 呢個真係一個悲傷嘅故事 ... 佢好耐之前賣咗佢嘅靈魂，雖然佢永遠都會陪伴，但係佢永遠都會孤獨，因為佢冇忠誠，只係佢最細個。當盞燈著緊嗰陣，佢都會見到個變形者。損害將會係逆轉唔到同無法修復嘅。佢嘅命運係佢爸爸嘅命運。兩者都係由佢內心嘅惡行引起，傀儡師會歡喜，因為佢除咗佢之外，冇其他人。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: My worst trouble was getting away from home on the morning of starting. Mother and my sisters, of course, shed a few tears; but my father, stern and unbending in his manner, gave me his benediction in these words: "Thomas Moore, you're the third son to leave our roof, but your father's blessing goes with you. I left my own home beyond the sea before I was your age." And as they all stood at the gate, I climbed into my saddle and rode away, with a lump in my throat which left me speechless to reply.

jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 maa4 faan4 ge3 hai6 hai2 ceot1 faat3 ge3 ziu1 zou2 lei4 hoi1 uk1 kei2，dong1 jin4，maa4 maa1 tung4 ngo5 di1 zi2 mui6 lau4 zo2 gei2 dik6 ngaan5 leoi6；daan6 hai6 ngo5 baa4 baa1，ji5 keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6 jim4 suk1 tung4 gin1 ding6，jung6 ni1 di1 syut3 waa6 hoeng3 ngo5 zuk1 fuk1：「tok3 maa5 si1 · mo1 ji5，nei5 hai6 dai6 saam1 go3 lei4 hoi1 ngo5 dei6 uk1 deng2 go3 zai2，daan6 nei5 baa1 baa1 ge3 zuk1 fuk1 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4。ngo5 lei4 hoi1 zo2 ngo5 zi6 gei2 ge3 gaa1，hai2 ngo5 ge3 si4 hau6，ngo5 dei6 dou1 hou2 ci5 nei5 dei6 gam3 soeng1 sam1 gam2 paa4 zo2 lok6 hoi2。」ngo5 hau4 lung4 jau5 go3 zung2 faai3，ling6 ngo5 mou4 jin4 ji5 deoi3 gam2 wui4 fuk1。
text: 我最麻煩嘅係喺出發嘅朝早離開屋企，當然，媽媽同我啲姊妹流咗幾滴眼淚；但係我爸爸，以佢嘅態度嚴肅同堅定，用呢啲說話向我祝福：「托馬斯 · 摩爾，你係第三個離開我哋屋頂個仔，但你爸爸嘅祝福同你一齊。我離開咗我自己嘅家，喺我嘅時候，我哋都好似你哋咁傷心噉爬咗落海。」我喉嚨有個腫塊，令我無言以對噉回覆。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: With this bomb we have now added a new and revolutionary increase in destruction to supplement the growing power of our armed forces. In their present form these bombs are now in production and even more powerful forms are in development. It is an atomic bomb. It is a harnessing of the basic power of the universe. The force from which the sun draws its power has been loosed against those who brought war to the Far East.

jyutping: jau5 zo2 nei1 go3 zaa3 daan2，ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zang1 gaa1 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 tung4 gaak3 ming6 sing3 ge3 po3 waai6 zang1 gaa1，ji5 bou2 cung1 ngo5 dei6 mou5 zong1 bou6 deoi2 jat6 jik1 zang1 zoeng2 ge3 lik6 loeng6。ji5 keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 jing4 sik1，ni1 di1 zaa3 daan2 ji4 gaa1 hoi1 ci2 saang1 caan2，ji4 gang1 koeng4 daai6 ge3 jing4 sik1 jik6 dou1 hai2 dou6 hoi1 faat3 gan2。 keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 jyun4 zi2 daan2。 ni1 go3 hai6 lei6 jung6 jyu5 zau6 ge3 gei1 bun2 lik6 loeng6。 taai3 joeng4 cung4 zung1 cau1 ceoi2 lik6 loeng6 ge3 lik6 loeng6，ji5 ging1 deoi3 go2 di1 daai2 lai4 jyun5 dung1 ge3 zin3 zaang1 ge3 jan4 sung1 zo2。
text: 有咗呢個炸彈，我哋而家增加咗一個新嘅同革命性嘅破壞增加，以補充我哋武裝部隊日益增長嘅力量。以佢哋而家嘅形式，呢啲炸彈而家開始生產，而更強大嘅形式亦都喺度開發緊。 佢係一個原子彈。 呢個係利用宇宙嘅基本力量。 太陽從中抽取力量嘅力量，已經對嗰啲帶嚟遠東嘅戰爭嘅人鬆咗。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: However, whether they are gods depends on definition. In many religious traditions, a god isn’t just powerful but also a fundamental source of existence—either creating the universe (transcendent) or embodying it (immanent). Extraterrestrials, no matter how advanced, might still be contingent beings—products of the same cosmic processes as us—rather than the ultimate origin of reality. So, they could be deemed gods by some, but philosophically, they might not fit the full criteria.

jyutping: daan6 hai6，keoi5 dei6 hai6 mai6 san4 hai6 ceoi2 kyut3 jyu1 ding6 ji6。hai2 hou2 do1 zung1 gaau3 cyun4 tung2 jap6 min6，san4 m4 daan1 zi2 hai6 koeng4 daai6 ge3，jik6 dou1 hai6 cyun4 zoi6 ge3 gei1 bun2 loi4 jyun4 —— jiu3 hai6 cong3 zou6 jyu5 zau6（ciu1 jyut6）waak6 ze2 tai2 jin6 jyu5 zau6（noi6 zoi6）。dei6 ngoi6 saang1 mat6，mou4 leon6 gei2 sin1 zeon3，dou1 ho2 nang4 jing4 jin4 hai6 ngau5 jin4 cyun4 zoi6 —— tung4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 joeng6 ge3 jyu5 zau6 gwo3 cing4 ge3 caan2 mat6 —— ji4 m4 hai6 jin6 sat6 ge3 zeoi3 zung1 hei2 jyun4。so2 ji5，keoi5 dei6 ho2 nang4 wui6 bei2 jat1 di1 jan4 si6 wai4 san4，daan6 hai6 hai2 zit3 hok6 soeng6，keoi5 dei6 ho2 nang4 m4 fu4 hap6 so2 jau5 biu1 zeon2。
text: 但係，佢哋係咪神係取決於定義。喺好多宗教傳統入面，神唔單止係強大嘅，亦都係存在嘅基本來源 —— 要係創造宇宙（超越）或者體現宇宙（內在）。地外生物，無論幾先進，都可能仍然係偶然存在 —— 同我哋一樣嘅宇宙過程嘅產物 —— 而唔係現實嘅最終起源。所以，佢哋可能會畀一啲人視為神，但係喺哲學上，佢哋可能唔符合所有標準。
